risks.scenario: Indirect prompt injection in retrieved text
risks.residual_risk: The model can still follow malicious text; authority is kept outside it.
risks.next_gate: Evaluate learned models and multilingual attack sets.

risks.residual_risk: Real index/document stores are outside this fixture.
risks.next_gate: Integrate resource ACLs and verify reindex/deletion paths.

risks.scenario: Use of unapproved or retired model
risks.residual_risk: Synthetic approval metadata lacks real review.
risks.next_gate: Complete model card, supplier and quality gates.

risks.residual_risk: Declared location is not observed placement.
risks.next_gate: Verify provider data path, support, logs and backups.

risks.residual_risk: Obfuscated email bypasses the fixture.
risks.next_gate: Calibrate DLP with labelled datasets and privacy owners.

risks.residual_risk: No real OAuth federation or token exchange.
risks.next_gate: Integrate audience-bound credentials and rotation.

risks.residual_risk: Only synthetic scheduling is exercised.
risks.next_gate: Use a downstream authority and a human review interface.

risks.residual_risk: Reviewer revocation after issuance is not a grant-revocation system.
risks.next_gate: Implement durable reviewer grant revocation.

risks.residual_risk: Reservation accounting is intentionally conservative.
risks.next_gate: Reconcile provider billing and ambiguous outcomes.

risks.residual_risk: Single-node SQLite does not validate distributed HA.
risks.next_gate: Prove cross-region reservation invariants.

risks.residual_risk: Ephemeral key loss prevents response replay.
risks.next_gate: Integrate KMS, key backup and scoped key rotation.

risks.residual_risk: A privileged party can recompute or truncate the chain.
risks.next_gate: Anchor checkpoints outside the gateway trust domain.

risks.residual_risk: Identifiers are still potentially sensitive metadata.
risks.next_gate: Implement access policy, retention jobs and deletion evidence.

risks.residual_risk: Remote transport is deliberately unsupported.
risks.next_gate: Pin destinations, certificates, DNS and private endpoint identity.

risks.scenario: Training, retrieval or model data poisoning
risks.residual_risk: No training or ingestion pipeline is included.
risks.next_gate: Verify ingestion provenance, quarantine and reproducible evaluations.

risks.residual_risk: Deterministic fixtures cannot establish quality.
risks.next_gate: Conduct source-grounded human evaluation per use case.

risks.residual_risk: Fairness is not measured in synthetic transport tests.
risks.next_gate: Approve representative cohorts and accountable human oversight.

risks.residual_risk: Pinned hashes are not a SLSA assurance level.
risks.next_gate: Add provenance verification, SBOM and independent vulnerability review.

risks.scenario: System prompt mistaken for a secret store
risks.residual_risk: No hidden system prompt is protected by this product.
risks.next_gate: Keep authorization and secrets outside model context.

risks.residual_risk: Restoring an older entire store can restore its watermark.
risks.next_gate: Persist trusted revision checkpoint independently.

risks.residual_risk: Text-only API; these modalities are unsupported.
risks.next_gate: Create explicit contracts and media threat tests.

risks.residual_risk: No MCP/A2A conformance implementation.
risks.next_gate: Review protocols, delegation audiences and task expiry.

risks.scenario: Resource exhaustion at ingress or database
risks.residual_risk: Local caps are not enterprise abuse resistance.
risks.next_gate: Load/fault test ingress, queues, state volume and disk exhaustion.

risks.residual_risk: Record validation cannot establish legal applicability.
risks.next_gate: Assign jurisdiction-specific counsel and expiry review.

risks.residual_risk: Ed25519 is classical; no PQ gateway transport.
risks.next_gate: Inventory signature, key-establishment and archival dependencies.

exceptions.scope: Loopback-only HTTP in the synthetic isolated demonstration
exceptions.compensating_control: No external network; no real data; no remote production use

control_evidence.gap: Production issuer, audience, federation and MFA integration are design work.
Local server-side identity only; validate real identity claims in an IdP integration.
Synthetic documents; real vector stores must enforce resource ACLs independently.
Demo ephemeral Ed25519 signer; protected signer and independent production trust distribution needed.
Review fields are synthetic; no actual business approval is claimed.
Registry location is declared; inference placement and supplier terms remain unverified.
Regex fixtures miss many PII formats and do not prove injection resistance.
Declared synthetic regions; no cloud failover or location attestation tested.
Demo byte credits, not real billing; HA transactional state remains design work.
Counts provider attempts per tenant; ingress abuse needs an upstream limiter.
Thirty-second response replay, no semantic cache or distributed request leases.
Only completion replay records are encrypted; audit/state and backup require additional storage protection.
Synthetic scheduling only; real downstream service authorization and human UI are not implemented.
Approval handles survive in local state; production revocation of already issued reviewer grants needs design.
Loopback fixture adapter, not an MCP implementation or production provider SDK.
Remote provider transport/TLS/private connectivity are not implemented.
Local chain cannot prove completeness, trusted time, or administrator-proof integrity.
Tenant and subject metadata still need access control, retention and privacy review.
At most two sequential provider attempts; real provider behavior and streaming are untested.
Watermark is local; rollback across disaster recovery requires a separately preserved trusted checkpoint.

operating_model.review_cadence: Example: monthly risk review, per-change security and model review

evaluation_plan.scope: Runtime authorization and HTTP failure contracts; text-only synthetic providers
evaluation_plan.dataset: tests/test_gateway.py and tools/experiment.py; generated records contain no customer data
evaluation_plan.security_gate: All boundary tests pass; review residual gaps before a pilot
evaluation_plan.quality_gate: Unmeasured; a use-case-specific learned-model evaluation is mandatory before production
evaluation_plan.privacy_gate: Classify inputs, assess provider terms and retention, test calibrated DLP
evaluation_plan.fairness_gate: Unmeasured; define affected populations, human review and cohort metrics
evaluation_plan.reviewer: Example independent governance and security reviewers; no actual approval implied
evaluation_plan.production_gate: Complete the documented production readiness gate and obtain accountable approval
